reason: The previous candidate installed on an affected console but did not open hbmenu. This HEN adds automatic first-native-game policy capture and has not been device-tested.
validation_scope: The previous candidate's same-boot receipt verified matched RO/HEN/bootstrap startup, Moader resident/FS connection, restored cache and closed listener. The owner reached hbmenu after two R launches of Pokemon Z-A with a previously saved game policy; an affected tester still reported no hbmenu. Host regressions for this HEN cover automatic stock first-launch capture without an R sample, fresh FullKey input and a still-closing Seedsow process. None of those changes is isolated on hardware.
